title: Mison: A Fast JSON Parser for Data Analytics
relevance: Introduced speculative field location prediction for JSON parsing based on previously observed patterns, directly inspiring our row-length prediction approach.

title: Parallel In-Situ Data Processing with Speculative Loading
relevance: Speculative loading of data for in-situ processing -- predicts data access patterns for parallel execution, same principle as speculative row prediction.

title: Optimal Prediction for Prefetching in the Worst Case
relevance: Theoretical foundation for optimal prefetching via prediction, connecting data compression and prediction -- a compressor that models row lengths well can also predict them.

title: Optimal Prefetching via Data Compression
relevance: Shows that good data compressors make good predictors for prefetching, providing theoretical justification for using entropy-based row-length prediction.
